summary: A sponsored seasonal guide to visiting Dubai, covering winter outdoor and heritage activities, May beach clubs and festivals, and June–July waterparks and evening sightseeing. It is paired with promotion of British Airways Holidays, which offers ATOL-protected packages with low deposits, a 23 kg baggage allowance and 24/7 support.
one_line: A British Airways Holidays-sponsored guide to what to do in Dubai in winter, May and the hot months of June and July.
key_facts: November and December are the best months for outdoor activities in Dubai, with cooler temperatures, clear blue skies and balmy weather.
Dubai's desert offers dune buggies, quad biking and desert safaris, and is home to gazelles, reptiles and the Arabian Oryx, a species saved from the brink of extinction.
Desert safaris include traditional activities like henna tattooing and dance shows, and many end with an evening BBQ dinner.
Abras, traditional wooden boats at Dubai Creek in Deira, are the oldest form of public transport in Dubai.
Al Fahidi Fort in the Al Fahidi Historical neighbourhood is one of the oldest buildings in Dubai, built in 1787.
Hatta offers hiking in the Hajar mountains, one of the highest ranges in the Arabian peninsula, and Hatta Heritage Village, a reconstruction of a traditional mountain village.
Dubai Design Week takes place around the start of November and is the region's largest creative festival.
May has average temperatures around 30 degrees; the Dubai Food Festival is held at the beginning of the month and the Dubai Comedy Festival later in May.
Beach options include SĀN Beach and DRIFT Beach Dubai; dining options include Akira Back (Dubai Marina views) and Fish Beach Taverna (Aegean seafood).
Wild Wadi is the city's first-ever waterpark; Laguna Waterpark is a newer park on the coast with an infinity pool and its own beach.
In June and July, sightseeing can be done at night, such as dinner cruises on Dubai Creek, the Burj Khalifa at sunset, the Burj Al Arab lights, and the 153-metre-high Dubai Frame.
British Airways Holidays offers deposits from £75 per person, with balance due 4 weeks before short haul travel or 7 weeks for long haul, 23 kg baggage, Avios payments and a 24/7 helpline.
